title: spergula arvensis var. pomeliana
intro: Spergula arvensis var. pomeliana, commonly known as the corn spurry, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Spergula arvensis var. pomeliana include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
